title: Smeltable Raw Ore Blocks (1.21.Xׁׁ)
description: Tired of managing dozens of furnaces? Upgrade your smelting game! This datapack allows you to smelt Raw Gold, Iron, and Copper Blocks directly into their processed versions.
body:
# 🧱 Heavy Metals: Industrial Refinement

### Tired of the furnace clutter?
We’ve all been there: coming back from a mining trip with stacks of raw iron, only to realize you need to build a literal wall of furnaces just to smelt it all before next week.

Heavy Metals solves the logistics nightmare without breaking the game's balance.

## 💎 Why use this?
- One Slot, Nine Items: Smelt a whole Raw Iron/Gold/Copper Block in a single furnace slot.
- Compact Bases: Reduce your "furnace room" size by 90%.
- Vanilla Logic: No magic, no cheats. It takes the same time and gives the same XP as 9 individual ingots ($1800$ ticks).
## 🛠️ How it works:
1. Craft your Raw Ores into Raw Blocks (9 ingots block).
2. Toss the raw block into Furnace
3. Get a solid metal block back!
